svg.title: At the halfway pass the sampler tells the model t = 0.50, but in training half the team was hidden at t = 0.65. Telling the model the corrected t moved its choices by 0.005 on today's default model and 0.008 on a model trained on the shuffled-only table, both under the bar of 0.01.
